(2) Starting has Starting->Stopping and Starting->Stopped edges, covered by Stop_during_starting_reaches_stopped_and_stops_the_process and Real_stop_during_starting_leaves_no_child; (3) no terminal transition exists outside StopCore, and StopCore only transitions after a successful tracked-tree stop/verification, with terminal-while-running assertions in natural, cancel and failed tests; (4) root-exit children are retained by a fixed-point closure, a root-PID anchor for a child row read after the root row vanished, and a real python3 fork/reparent test Real_root_exit_keeps_a_tracked_child_and_stop_reaps_it; (5) failed starts attempt kill and wait and throw ProcessOrphanedException when reaping cannot be proven, covered by Failed_start_reports_the_orphan_when_kill_and_wait_fail; (6) IProcessLauncher extends IAsyncDisposable so shutdown cleanup is reachable through the interface, covered by Real_launcher_shutdown_leaves_no_child;
